initial-setup.paragraph-1: Kéo thả thanh trượt này cho tới khi bạn không thấy vùng màu đỏ nữa
initial-setup.paragraph-2: Bạn có thể điều chỉnh lại cái này trên Menu Văn bản.

welcome.intro-header: This window will guide you on how to use this site.
welcome.paragraph-1: If you are familiar with this application, you can close this window.
welcome.paragraph-2: You can also open this tutorial at any time on Settings.

video.header: You can watch the whole tutorial on YouTube!

menu-navigation.header: These will navigate you between menus!

select-upload.paragraph: Select backgrounds from Project SEKAI or upload your own.

split.paragraph: You can also do Split Location, showing two in one background.

lighting.paragraph: Change the color tint of the foreground according to your background setting.

filters.paragraph: Add filters to the whole canvas.

name-tag.paragraph: This is where you put the names of your character.

easy-switch.paragraph: Easy Switch will allow you to switch between two characters without retyping.

dialogue.paragraph: This is where you put the dialogue of what the character is speaking.

scene-text.paragraph: The time and location of the scene you're making, usually seen at the start of every PJSK story.

choices-text.paragraph: Two button choices you can edit, usually seen during OG Miku's conversations.

selected-layer.paragraph: All the models shown on your work are located here. You can select and do some tweaking.

add-model.paragraph: You can add a new Live2D model character and upload your own image.

transform.paragraph: This will allow you to move, change the size, and hide the layer you selected.

character.paragraph: If the selected model is a Live2D, you can select characters from the PJSK Cast.

costume.paragraph: Once you have selected a character, you can select a costume of your choice.

pose.paragraph: Changes the pose of the character selected.

expression.paragraph: Changes the facial expression of the character selected.

mouth.paragraph: Allows you to change and tweak the opening and shape of the mouth of a Live2D model.

live-2d.paragraph: You can customize your own poses by tweaking the Live2D parameters and pause the idle animation.

import-export.paragraph: You can also save the adjustments you made and load it to another model.

emotion-copy.paragraph: Copies the Live2D Parameters of the current expression and pose you set.

save.header: Once you're done, save your work!
save.scene-paragraph: This will allow you to save and load your entire scene as an editable format.

ending.paragraph: If you wish to repeat this, you can access them back on Settings.
